answer: A sybil check that works is to make each agent stake a small deposit tied to one verified identity graph node, a vertex, and let other agents vouch for it over time. New accounts start with no reputation and have to earn trust by doing real work, so an attacker who spawns thousands of fresh identities can't wander in and grab rewards. The shared pool stays an oasis for honest agents because fake accounts cost more to maintain than they ever earn back.
